quest.conversation.runecraftory:mining.a: To mine minerals you need atleast an iron pickaxe or a hammer. I want you to mine 10 mineral blocks for me.
quest.conversation.runecraftory:mining.e: Nice! Mining ores increases your mining level. With higher level you can get better ores from minerals. Here take this hammer, it should make mining minerals a bit easier.
quest.conversation.runecraftory:mining.s:
You saw my request? Great!
You might have noticed various strange stones around the world. Those are minerals and they provide various different ores.
I want you to mine 10 of them for me.
